tests.canonical_name: BEST inner to outer zone transfer
tests.cross_section_treatment: scan registered models; none selected post-result
tests.falsification_criterion: FAIL at test level if any equally/less complex declared baseline matches or improves held-out performance, or transfer residuals violate the preregistered calibration rule.
tests.hypothesis: A frozen model with genuine spatial structure should transfer from inner calibration to outer observations.
tests.pass_criterion: PASS at test level only if frozen LSC held-out performance is better than every declared simpler baseline under the primary covariance source and does not reverse across credible sensitivity scenarios; no discovery claim.
tests.scientific_question: Does an inner-derived frozen specification predict the outer zone without refit?

tests.canonical_name: BEST outer to inner zone transfer
tests.falsification_criterion: FAIL if reverse mapping is identified and frozen transfer is no better than a simpler baseline; otherwise report BLOCKED, never PASS.
tests.hypothesis: If the frozen mapping is identifiable from outer data, it should transfer to inner observations.
tests.pass_criterion: Same model-comparison rule as T1, conditional on a preregistered proof that reverse mapping is identified.
tests.scientific_question: Is reverse zone transfer mathematically identified and predictive without refit?

tests.cross_section_treatment: all registered models and shared-isotope treatment
tests.falsification_criterion: Component-level failure if transfer fails for a preregistered experiment/isotope or a simpler baseline matches/improves held-out score.
tests.holdout_subset: GALLEX Cr, SAGE 51Cr and SAGE 37Ar source observations
tests.hypothesis: Frozen LSC structure should predict GALLEX and both SAGE isotope datasets without changing LSC parameters.
nuisance_treatment: experiment normalization may be fitted only inside M4 baseline
tests.pass_criterion: PASS only if all specified hold-out experiment groups outperform declared simpler baselines under the frozen comparison rule.
tests.scientific_question: Does the frozen BEST specification transfer across independent gallium experiments without refit?
tests.timing_requirement: exact source time needed only for temporal variants

covariance_requirement: same declared scenario for calibration and hold-out
tests.falsification_criterion: FAIL if transfer does not generalize to either preregistered BEST zone or a simpler baseline is equal/better.
tests.hypothesis: A cross-experiment frozen mapping should predict both BEST zones from GALLEX/SAGE calibration.
nuisance_treatment: baseline/nuisance fitting confined to calibration subset
tests.pass_criterion: PASS only if both BEST zones satisfy the preregistered held-out comparison against simpler baselines.
tests.scientific_question: Does a non-BEST calibration transfer to BEST without refit?

tests.cross_section_treatment: all registered 51Cr/37Ar pairs; no default correct model
tests.falsification_criterion: Component-level falsification if a future collaboration-covariance run shows preregistered frozen isotope transfer is no better than simpler baselines.
tests.hypothesis: A frozen energy dependence should transfer from 51Cr datasets to SAGE 37Ar.
tests.pass_criterion: No inferential PASS is authorized under assumption-only covariance; report stability or reversal across the full preregistered scan.
tests.scientific_question: Does frozen energy/isotope dependence transfer without refit?

tests.falsification_criterion: FAIL if preregistered aggregate or influence criterion fails, or any omitted split is hidden.
tests.holdout_subset: each omitted primary exposure in deterministic source order
tests.hypothesis: A frozen model should predict every omitted run without refitting its parameters.
nuisance_treatment: baseline/nuisance fitting inside each training fold only
tests.pass_criterion: PASS only if every fold is disclosed and aggregate held-out performance beats declared simpler baselines under an inferentially valid covariance.
tests.scientific_question: Are predictions stable for every omitted source exposure?
tests.timing_requirement: source interval sufficient for scalar LORO
tests.train_calibration_subset: SPLIT_LORO_*: all but one eligible primary exposure

covariance_requirement: cross-experiment covariance or declared sensitivity policy
tests.falsification_criterion: FAIL if any preregistered family transfer fails or a simpler baseline is equal/better overall.
tests.hypothesis: A frozen model should predict each held-out experiment family without parameter refit.
nuisance_treatment: baseline/nuisance fitting inside training families only
tests.pass_criterion: PASS only if every declared family hold-out is reported and frozen LSC is better than simpler baselines under the preregistered rule.
tests.scientific_question: Does the frozen model generalize across experiment families?

tests.cross_section_treatment: all registry entries; none declared correct
tests.falsification_criterion: Model support is weakened if its advantage disappears across credible registered alternatives.
tests.hypothesis: A defensible result should not depend on post-result selection of one cross-section model.
nuisance_treatment: shared nuclear nuisance per declared covariance scenario
tests.pass_criterion: SENSITIVITY_ONLY: report whether ordering/conclusion is stable; no discovery/exclusion/sigma/decisive language.
tests.prediction_target: model-comparison stability across registered cross-section alternatives
tests.scientific_question: Are conclusions robust to published capture cross-section alternatives?

tests.falsification_criterion: Model support is weakened if advantage disappears across credible scenarios or requires one post-selected assumption.
tests.hypothesis: A credible advantage should survive reasonable predeclared systematic treatments.
nuisance_treatment: all nuisance registry categories applicable to each dataset
tests.pass_criterion: SENSITIVITY_ONLY: report complete scenario envelope without inferential significance language.
tests.scientific_question: Are comparisons robust to preregistered nuisance/correlation scenarios?

tests.falsification_criterion: Component/model support fails if M3 or a simpler baseline is equal/better, or a valid preregistered external mapping excludes the required region.
tests.hypothesis: Frozen LSC must outperform M3 out of sample after declared complexity treatment to claim an advantage.
nuisance_treatment: M3 and baseline parameters only; frozen LSC never fit
tests.observable: rates/ratios; external native observables after mapping
tests.pass_criterion: PASS only if frozen LSC improves held-out prediction after declared complexity treatment and no valid mapped external constraint excludes its required region.
tests.prediction_target: held-out gallium rates plus separately mapped external constraints
tests.scientific_question: Does frozen LSC predict better than the standard sterile benchmark?
tests.timing_requirement: scalar test does not require precise timing
tests.train_calibration_subset: preregistered gallium calibration split for M3 only

tests.falsification_criterion: Model support fails if any simpler baseline is equal or better on preregistered held-out performance.
tests.hypothesis: Frozen LSC must outperform M0/M1/M2/M4 without parameter refit.
nuisance_treatment: baseline/nuisance fitting only; frozen LSC never fit
tests.pass_criterion: PASS only at test level if frozen LSC strictly improves held-out prediction over every declared simpler baseline after complexity treatment.
tests.scientific_question: Does frozen LSC add out-of-sample predictive value beyond simpler explanations?
tests.train_calibration_subset: preregistered split-specific calibration for baselines only

tests.falsification_criterion: Future component-level falsification follows only a preregistered adequately powered directional test; current absence of data is not a pass or fail.
tests.hypothesis: A complete authentic tensor and frame mapping must yield a preregistered directional/sidereal prediction.
tests.orientation_requirement: surveyed detector/source orientation plus complete active tensor and frame transforms
tests.pass_criterion: No PASS criterion is executable until the historical scientific statistic and all directional inputs are frozen.
tests.scientific_question: Can the frozen directional/tensor component predict time/orientation dependence?
specification_gaps: PASS/FAIL statistic and power criterion remain SPECIFICATION_INCOMPLETE.
tests.timing_requirement: precise event/sub-run timing; exposure midpoint explicitly forbidden
